caption: The video captures a heavily out-of-focus, elevated view of a forested mountain valley, where a blue lake sits in the lower center bordered by green hillsides and tan-brown cleared patches on the right slopes. A broad horizontal band of white-blue cloud stretches across the middle of the frame, partly veiling the far shore and the hills behind the water. Foreground treetops line the bottom edge. The cloud mass slowly drifts and changes shape across the excerpt, its lower edge on the right shifting so that more of the brown terrain and the lake's far shore become intermittently visible. On the left, the cloud thins and moves, altering how much of the green hillside is obscured. The lake, hills, and cleared patches shift slightly across the frame, indicating a moving camera, while clouds also drift over the terrain. No new object enters or leaves. The visible process is the fog band's gradual deformation and drift across the landscape.
